change_summary: Pass 1: replaced two separate tl.where calls with a single x_masked = tl.where(mask, x, 0.0) reused for both x_sum and x_sum2 accumulations to enable FMA fusion. Pass 2: pre-computed scalar bias = libdevice.fma(-mean, inv_std, 0.0) outside the loop and replaced (x - mean) * inv_std with libdevice.fma(x, inv_std, bias) inside the loop to convert FSUB+FMUL pairs into single FFMA instructions.
